4. INSTALL RING GEAR ON DIFFERENTIAL CASE
Case Side (a) Clean the contact surface of the differential case.
(b) Heat the ring gear in boiling water.
{c) Carefully take the ring gear out of the water.
(d) After the moisture on the ring gear has completely evapo-
rated, quickly install the ring gear to the differential case.
HINT:
Align the matchmarks on the differential case and contact the
y 007315 ring gear.
(e) Temporarily install the 8 set bolts.
CAUTION:
The rlng gear set bolts should not be tightened until the
ring gear has cooled sufficiently.
(f) After the ring gear has cooled sufficiently, torque the ring
gear set bolts uniformly at a time.
Torque: 77 N.m (790 kgf-cm, 57 ft-lbf)
